visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair, wearing an olive green overshirt over a white T-shirt and black trousers, walks along a covered urban sidewalk. He speaks to the camera with an expressive face, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his points. The background features a street with parked motorcycles, a few pedestrians, and various shops with colorful signs and displays. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, casting soft shadows. (2) The man pauses and points his right hand towards a row of storefronts across the street. The camera view shifts to a street scene lined with parked cars and motorcycles. On-screen text labels including "迷客夏", "一沐日", and "50嵐" appear sequentially above the shops. The background remains an urban street with concrete pavements and overhead structures. (3) The man is seen inside a brightly lit, modern beverage shop. He stands at a white service counter, looking at a digital menu and his smartphone. A staff member's hand and a POS terminal are visible. The shop interior has clean white and light wood aesthetics with warm-toned pendant lights hanging from the ceiling. (4) The man sits indoors against a grey wall decorated with black text decals that read "世界有點苦 我想給你一點甜". On the table in front of him are several takeaway drink cups in a plastic bag. He picks up a tall teal-colored cup and takes a sip through a purple straw, looking directly into the lens with a satisfied expression. (5) Three circular graphic icons representing different people appear floating on the screen as the man continues talking and gesturing with both hands. He ends by pointing downwards towards where the call-to-action text appears. The lighting remains consistent and bright within the interior setting.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video analyzes the competitive landscape of the hand-shaken beverage industry in Taiwan, emphasizing the low entry barriers and high profit margins that attract entrepreneurs and influencers. The creator reviews a premium-priced drink and asks viewers for their opinions on which influencer-led franchise is the best to join.
